rows.note: Use 節 for a numbered unit of a song or a holy book, with the context showing which one is meant.

example.english: This song has four verses before the chorus, and the last verse is the most moving.
example.traditional: 呢首歌去到副歌前有四節，最後嗰節最感人。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 heoi3 dou3 fu3 go1 cin4 jau5 sei3 zit3 zeoi3 hau6 go2 zit3 zeoi3 gam2 jan4

rows.note: 詩 is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for poetry in general.

example.english: I loved reading Tang-dynasty verse when I was young.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 duk6 tong4 si1

rows.note: Use 詩體 when discussing verse as a formal poetic style with regular meter and rhyme rather than poetry in general.

example.english: This poem is written in a classical verse form, with attention to tonal patterns and rhyme.
example.traditional: 呢首詩用古典詩體寫成，講究平仄同押韻。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau2 si1 jung6 gu2 din2 si1 tai2 se2 sing4 gong2 gau3 ping4 zak1 tung4 aat3 wan6
